fresh.description: Fresh save: five permanent 2-skill / 76-aptitude / 1.00-growth turtles; one enters first, one per interval; save only real service-generated skill upgrades; no ads or injected stats.

mature.description: Separate explicit 4–6-skill archive fixture representing later fusion progress; no claim these skills were earned in the first run. Same 76 innate aptitudes; training paid through GameService using only previously earned gold/materials; first wave still one turtle.
